title: Federation draft updates: broadcast mentions in Peer/deliver
description:
Update draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md so Peer/deliver and related payloads carry broadcast-scope mentions.

Blocked on jmap-chat-spec-fig9.2 (main draft must define wire format first).

Current state: the federation draft's Peer/deliver carries `mentions` as Mention[] (lines 205, 214, 219, 228 in earlier survey). Per-user mentions work; broadcast mentions have no current representation.

Likely scope:
- Update Mention[] payload structure in Peer/deliver, edit, retract, etc. to carry the type discriminator from jmap-chat-spec-fig9.2
- Define receiver-side resolution semantics: the receiving server computes its own local recipient set for `@here` and `@admins` (the sender's server may have computed a different set; it is not authoritative)
- Update validation at lines 269-271 (edit and reactionUpdate payload validation) to handle new mention types
- Ensure suppression rules apply consistently for received broadcast mentions

Cross-document consistency: field names match main draft and push draft.
acceptance_criteria:
- Peer/deliver payload structure updated for typed mentions
- Receiver-side recipient resolution semantics explicit (delivery-time on receiving server is authoritative for badging/push)
- Validation rules updated
- Edit and reactionUpdate payloads consistent
- Cross-document field name consistency
close_reason: Added broadcastMentions to Peer/deliver message and edit payloads; new §Broadcast Mention Resolution subsection codifies receiver-authoritative rule and the no-send-time-set-trust rule; validation extended (step 10); edit-validation extended to invoke steps 9 and 10; Security Considerations subsection added on resolution trust and federation-side opt-out non-disclosure.
